FIVE TOOLING DEFECTS FOUND BY TESTING RATHER THAN TRUSTING
  1. rules/01's own off-8pt regex matches only ODD teens: 18px, 20px, 28px, 36px
     all passed it. Replaced with membership testing.
  2. font-size:\s*[^v]  -- \s* matches zero spaces so [^v] ate the space itself,
     flagging every legitimate var().
  3. insert .* here     -- greedy across a whole line.
  4. TODO|TBD|XXX       -- unbounded, matched inside ordinary words.
  5. \[[A-Z]...\]       -- matched JS array literals like [Math.max(...)].
